summary.text: Stephanie Saenz is the Democratic candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican incumbent Denise Villalobos.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a Corpus Christi native who has worked in public education for nearly 30 years.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey completed in 2026, Saenz's response described her as Stephanie Guerrero Sáenz, born and raised in Corpus Christi.
The response says she has been a public school teacher for nearly 30 years and has been active in local civic and cultural organizations, her church and the Democratic Party.
It lists her past roles as Organizing Director of the Nueces County Democratic Party and a member of the Texas State Democratic Executive Committee.
Her stated priorities include stronger public schools, higher teacher pay, universal pre-K, affordable health care, protecting natural resources and lower costs.
